title: The topological local dimensions at compatible rational points are preserved by scalar extension.
statement:
theorem topologicalKrullDimAt_rationalPoint_field_baseChange
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ X) (hp : p ≫ f = 𝟙 _)
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (q : Spec (.of K) ⟶ pullback f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))
    (hq : q ≫ pullback.snd f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) = 𝟙 _)
    (hqp : q ≫ pullback.fst f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)) ≫ p) :
    topologicalKrullDimAt (p (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) =
      topologicalKrullDimAt (q (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K))

proof.text: Choose an affine open Spec A containing the image of p. Its inverse image in the base change is the open chart Spec(A tensor_k K). Locally finite type gives finite type of A over k. The equation hqp gives contraction of the prime at q to the prime at p. Apply the affine tensor-product local dimension comparison. Use chart homeomorphisms and cofinality of open chart neighbourhoods to transport the equality.
